concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-control-panel-reporting-expiring-cards]] - Control Panel report for expired and soon-to-expire Vault cards, with date-range and all-expired views plus a boundary between report visibility, merchant reminders and separately enabled Account Updater requests
warnings: Do not describe running the report as updating vaulted payment methods, sending customer reminders, or enabling Account Updater.
Preserve the account-setup, Braintree Direct merchant and US qualifications on the separate Account Updater option.
Treat the 2026-09-16 raw as collected evidence, not proof of current report or Account Updater availability.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-control-panel-reporting-expiring-cards]] - Braintree report route for identifying expired or soon-to-expire cards used in recurring billing, distinct from merchant reminder outreach and the separately enabled, account-qualified Account Updater option
warnings: Keep report identification separate from customer outreach and automatic update requests.
Do not generalize the qualified Account Updater example to all Braintree merchants or infer successful card updates.
